rules.name: HARDY VETERANS (1)
rules.description: Use this ability when a model would be knocked down, Spend 1 power to gain the Steady ability for this attack. Models that already have Steady may re-roll the result. This ability may be used any number of time in a Round.

rules.name: Talannar’s Pack
rules.description: Northern Alliance Warbands may take 1 additional LARGE model than the game size would normally allow.

sharedRules.name: FRENZY (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability to gain 2 bonus dice when this model makes a Melee attack (not a Retaliation). Spend the power before rolling any dice. Cannot be used in conjunction with the normal use of Power to gain a bonus dice for a roll.

sharedRules.name: RAPID FIRE (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model is about to perform a ranged attack, before dice are rolled. The model may shoot twice at two different targets that are within 3" of each other following the normal targeting rules. This cannot be as part of a Group or Fatigue Action.

sharedRules.name: ICE BLAST (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when a model is knocked down by this elemental in Melee. The model must take a Nerve test. If the test is failed, the model is marked as Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Icy Breath (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when taking a Shoot action. Make a Ranged attack using an Ra value of 5+, 3D8, Range 9", Breath, Piercing (1).

sharedRules.name: Vicious Swipe
sharedRules.description: When attempting to Break Away from a Troll, enemy models have a -1 modifier when they make their Armour Save roll.

sharedRules.name: HEAD SWING (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when making a Melee attack (not a Retaliate) instead of rolling to hit as normal. Every enemy model that is Engaged with this model must make a Nerve test with a -1 Modifier. If any model fails its test, it is knocked-down and marked as Fatigued. Once all models have made a test, the Melee attack ends. Models may Retaliate if permitted to do so as normal.

sharedRules.name: BLADE MASTER (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model makes a Melee attack (including Retaliations) before dice are rolled. The Ice Blade may attack all enemy models it is Enaged with in its front arc by dividing the attack dice between them. Allocate the dice to be used for each enemy model before any are rolled. If the Ice Blade initiated the Fight, only one enemy model may Retaliate (enemy player’s choice) and only after all the Ice Blade’s attacks are resolved. Bonus die granted for the status of models (e.g. knocked-down) can only be allocated to that model).

sharedRules.name: Spell - Hold Fast
sharedRules.description:
Target a friendly model, even if it is Engaged. For the remainder of the Round, that model has a +1 modifier to any Nerve tests it is required to make and may add 1 bonus die to any Armour rolls it must take.

Boosted version: 

Cast as a long action instead. As above, but the modifier is increased to +2 and the bonus dice are increased to 2.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Winter’s Bite
sharedRules.description: If the target suffers any wounds, they are Knocked-down and marked as Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Frost Trident
sharedRules.description: For any wound caused by a Melee attack with the Frost-Trident, the target model is pinned in place until the end of their next activation. While the model is pinned their Sp is reduced to 0 and they cannot make a Break Away action.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Frost Hammer
sharedRules.description: A great two-handed hammer wielded by the Dwarf clans in the North. The model gains Crushing Strength (1) and increases its Ar by 1.

sharedRules.name: LASH (1)
sharedRules.description: use this ability when casting the Lightning Bolt spell to make it a short action to cast instead of a long action.

sharedRules.name: ICY BREATH (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when taking a Shoot action. Make a Ranged attack using an Ra value of 5+, 3D8, Range 9”, Breath, Piercing (1).
